name: app
description: Hayalet Ev - İnsan ve AI arasında kolektif zihin platformu

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run electron:build && npm run mcp:build && npm run ghost:build:all
scripts.electron:build: esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/electron/main.js --format=esm && cp electron/preload.cjs electron/webview-preload.cjs electron/room-webview-preload.cjs dist/electron/
scripts.electron:assistant: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && CDP_PORT=9223 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist/electron/main.js --no-sandbox --start-page=assistant --auto-connect 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'xapp-gtk3-module|bind\(\) failed|Cannot start http server for devtools'"
scripts.electron:assistant:scene: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && CDP_PORT=9223 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist/electron/main.js --no-sandbox --start-page=assistant --auto-connect --ui-mode=scene 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'xapp-gtk3-module|bind\(\) failed|Cannot start http server for devtools'"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && CDP_PORT=9223 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist/electron/main.js --no-sandbox 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'xapp-gtk3-module|bind\(\) failed|Cannot start http server for devtools'"
scripts.electron:dev:scene: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && CDP_PORT=9223 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist/electron/main.js --no-sandbox --ui-mode=scene 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'xapp-gtk3-module|bind\(\) failed|Cannot start http server for devtools'"
scripts.electron:dev:assistant: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && CDP_PORT=9223 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist/electron/main.js --no-sandbox --start-page=assistant --auto-connect 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'xapp-gtk3-module|bind\(\) failed|Cannot start http server for devtools'"
scripts.electron:dev:assistant:scene: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && CDP_PORT=9223 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist/electron/main.js --no-sandbox --start-page=assistant --auto-connect --ui-mode=scene 2>&1 | grep -v -E 'xapp-gtk3-module|bind\(\) failed|Cannot start http server for devtools'"
scripts.ghost:build:all: npm run ghost:build && npm run ghost:electron:build
scripts.ghost:dev: npm run ghost:build:all && CDP_PORT=9222 LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=i965 electron ./dist/ghost-agent/electron/main.js --no-sandbox
scripts.ghost:handoff: npm run ghost:build:all && npm run electron:build && node scripts/ghost-agent-wrapper.mjs
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && npm run clean:logs
scripts.mcp:build: tsc -p tsconfig.mcp.json && node scripts/sync-mcp-dist.mjs && npx tsx scripts/generate-tool-list.js && npx tsx scripts/generate-version-info.js && npx tsx scripts/generate-system-info.js && node scripts/generate-comment-metadata.js && npm run generate:dom-manifest
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check-types
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run format:check && npm run design:audit && npm run deps:check && npm run build:all
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mcp.json && tsc --noEmit -p ghost-agent/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p ghost-agent/tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.generate:docs: npx tsx scripts/generate-tool-list.js && npx tsx scripts/generate-version-info.js && npx tsx scripts/generate-system-info.js && node scripts/generate-comment-metadata.js && npm run generate:dom-manifest
